topic: How do interference mitigation techniques adapt when handling tunneled versus non-tunneled traffic in multi-beam satellite systems?
consensus_response: Interference mitigation techniques adapt by optimizing beamforming and rate-splitting multiple access. Non-uniform user distribution and aggressive frequency reuse increase inter-beam interference, straining system resources. Advanced beamforming techniques like hybrid beamforming dynamically adjust to changing traffic patterns, enhancing system capacity and user experience.
reference_context: Rate-splitting and beamforming mitigate inter-beam interference in multi-beam satellite systems, with machine learning optimizing beamforming for dynamic traffic patterns.
